verdict.rationale: Raygun documents deployment tracking through a Deployments API and says it tracks every deployment to identify new errors or regressions. It also records and filters errors by version and offers native GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab repo integrations, so errors can be tied to releases. Nothing in the pack shows each issue displaying the release it first appeared in, or identifying a suspect commit. Missing for 10: per-issue first-seen release display, suspect-commit attribution, commit-level linking docs, independent corroboration.
